Rebl Industries builds robotic workmates that companies subscribe to instead of buying. Our robots deploy in weeks, learn continuously and take over repetitive, heavy and precision-demanding tasks. With a unique Robot-as-a-Service model, we make automation flexible, scalable and accessible for businesses that want results without the traditional complexity and investment costs of automation projects. We’re a fast-growing, ambitious scale-up working at the intersection of robotics, AI, software and real-world production. Read more about us at www.rebl.industries
Do you want to own the hardware behind the next generation of robotic workmates? Join the team shaping the future of warehouse automation.
At Rebl Industries, we build robotic workmates that companies subscribe to instead of buying. Our robots are deployed within weeks, improve continuously, and take over repetitive, heavy, and precision-demanding tasks. Through our Robot-as-a-Service model, we make automation more flexible, scalable, and accessible for companies looking to modernize without the traditional complexity or large upfront investment. We’re a fast-growing scale-up operating at the intersection of robotics, AI, software, and industrial production. As our product portfolio and number of deployments grow, we are now looking for a Hardware Lead to bring our mechanical and electrical design together across teams.
What you will doAs Hardware Lead at Rebl, you will work horizontally across our cross-functional product teams and take overall ownership of hardware - mechanical design, electrical design, and component selection. You make sure that what we build is safe, durable over time, easy to manufacture, and easy to repair and maintain, while keeping the total cost of ownership low. In a Robot-as-a-Service model, where we own and operate the hardware throughout its life, these qualities make a direct difference.
You will develop new solutions together with our automation engineers and be a key point of contact for our hardware suppliers and engineering subcontractors. Your responsibilities include:
Leading mechanical design, electrical design, and component selection across multiple product teams
Ensuring designs are safe, durable, manufacturable, serviceable, and cost-effective over their full life cycle
Creating common hardware solutions and standards that the teams can reuse rather than reinvent
Driving innovation together with automation engineers, from early concepts and prototyping to deployment
Managing ongoing relationships with hardware suppliers and subcontractors within design, electrical systems, and mechanics

This is an on-site technical leadership role without direct reports where you will lead the work of contractors across disciplines. You will report to the CTO and be part of the Platform Team.
What we’re looking for
Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation & Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
Minimum 8 years of experience designing mechatronic systems
Experience with hardware common in logistics and industrial automation, such as industrial robots, safety equipment, industrial PCs, PLCs and networks, sensors and cameras, conveyors, pneumatics, and drive systems
Experience designing to industrial standards and regulations
Solid, hands-on experience managing supplier relationships and working with subcontractors within design, electrical systems, and mechanics
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Swedish and English

Your mindsetYou enjoy working across several products at once and thrive on balancing input from many different stakeholders. You move easily between the holistic view - seeing how the whole system fits together - and digging into the smallest details when it matters.
You are curious and open to working innovatively with AI, and you are not afraid to challenge traditional ways of working in hardware development. You are also happy to travel, a few days per month, both within Sweden and across Europe.
Why Rebl IndustriesAt Rebl Industries, you become part of a highly skilled and ambitious team where your contribution has immediate impact. You will help shape the future of robotic automation - not in theory, but through real deployments, real customers, and real industrial challenges. As we scale into new markets and new applications, your designs and technical decisions will define the hardware platform our robots are built on.
Apply nowIs this position the opportunity you have been waiting for? Please go ahead and apply! In this recruitment process, Rebl Industries collaborates with Mpya Sci & Tech. For questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Recruitment Consultant Johanna Engblom at +46 733 200 900. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to apply via www.mpyascitech.com, as the position may be filled before the final application date. Please note you must have the right to work in Sweden and that no relocation support is available.

Job Description
Are you passionate about the evolving creator economy and how creators can drive both brand relevance and commercial impact? We’re looking for a Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce to shape and build how we work with creator-led commerce at scale. 
In this role, you’ll lead the strategic direction of our creator affiliate offering and turn that strategy into scalable capabilities, ways of working and measurable business results. You’ll connect creator marketing, affiliate and commercial opportunities, ensuring our approach supports both short-term performance and long-term creator relationships. 
You’ll work closely with Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams to build a connected creator ecosystem and unlock the full potential of our creator partnerships across the business. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce, you’ll shape the strategy and build the capabilities required to grow creator commerce across markets. You’ll translate strategic priorities into clear plans, processes, tools and technology, while driving collaboration across teams and markets. 
You will: 
Define and drive the creator affiliate and commerce strategy, ensuring it complements the broader affiliate strategy and overall creator marketing direction. 
Build scalable operating models, processes, tools and technology that enable creator commerce across markets. 
Shape quarterly strategies, priorities and budget allocation within your area. 
Work closely with markets to identify commercial opportunities and define activation plans. 
Lead and guide Creator Marketing Specialists and Coordinators in campaign execution and delivery. 
Oversee campaign execution, budget management, performance and stakeholder alignment. 
Identify opportunities to maximise creator value across awareness, engagement and conversion. 
Build strong collaboration across Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams, ensuring partnerships and creator relationships are leveraged strategically across initiatives. 
Balance performance and commercial objectives with long-term creator relationships and strong brand alignment. 
Use performance insights and learnings to continuously evolve the creator commerce offering and identify new opportunities for growth. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We’re looking for a strategic and commercially minded creator marketing professional who combines deep expertise with a builder mentality. You’re comfortable setting direction, but equally motivated by turning strategy into something tangible, scalable and actionable. 
You understand both the relationship-driven side of creator marketing and the performance-driven nature of affiliate and creator commerce. You can navigate a complex stakeholder landscape, influence across teams and markets and turn business needs into clear operational and technical requirements. 
We are looking for people with: 
Extensive experience within creator, influencer or affiliate marketing, with strong expertise in creator commerce and performance-driven partnerships. 
Proven experience building or scaling creator-led commercial or affiliate programmes. 
Strong strategic planning and prioritisation skills, with the ability to translate strategy into execution. 
A solid understanding of affiliate platforms, tracking, attribution, tools and technology supporting creator commerce. 
A commercial mindset with a strong focus on measurable results, business impact and optimisation. 
Experience managing budgets, priorities and performance across multiple initiatives or markets. 
Excellent stakeholder management skills and confidence working across senior, cross-functional and international teams. 
Experience leading, coaching or guiding specialists and coordinators in campaign delivery. 
The ability to balance short-term commercial opportunities with long-term creator relationships and brand priorities. 
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with the drive to build new capabilities and ways of working.

 
WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter. 
 
 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.  
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Lead a Global Engineering Team as Manager, Machine Engineering 
As a Manager, Machine Engineering, you will lead a team of approximately 20 machine engineers located in Karlstad, Sweden and Copenhagen, Denmark supporting some of the world's most advanced pulp mills, biomass power plants, and energy projects. In this role, you will combine people leadership, project execution, and continuous improvement to help deliver high-quality engineering solutions across Europe, South America, and Asia. You will play a key role in shaping the future of our global engineering organization while developing both people and processes to support long-term business success. 
If you have a strong background in machine engineering, pulp technologies, and global team leadership, you can take on a senior role coordinating machine engineering across our global organization.
This position is preferably based in Karlstad, Sweden, or Copenhagen, Denmark, however, other locations in Sweden may also be considered.
Your responsibilities 
Lead and develop a team of machine engineers, supporting both project execution and competence development across the organization.  
Ensure high-quality, timely, and cost-effective engineering deliverables for sales, procurement, manufacturing, construction, and commissioning activities. 
Collaborate closely with the Mechanical Engineering Global Head, Engineering Excellence function, and other engineering leaders to continuously improve processes and ways of working. 
Drive a unified and global approach to machine engineering while building competence, flexibility, and collaboration across the global resource pool.  
Partner with internal stakeholders and external engineering companies to secure the right expertise and resources needed for successful project delivery and an excellent customer experience. 

Expectations for you 
You hold an M.Sc. degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. 
You demonstrate strong leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and change management capabilities. 
You have several years of experience within machine engineering and a proven track record in resource and team management. 
You have broad knowledge of machine engineering practices, project execution, and engineering processes in an industrial environment. 
You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. Additional language skills are a plus. 
You are willing to travel internationally when business needs require it. 

To succeed in this role 
Success in this position requires a combination of strong technical expertise, people leadership, and a global mindset. You are comfortable leading through change, building trust across teams, and balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic project environment. You know how to motivate and develop engineering talent while ensuring disciplined execution and continuous improvement.
We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles, practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: 
Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through 
Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly 
Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety 
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value 

We offer
You will become part of a global Mechanical Engineering Management Team supporting the Pulp, Energy and Circularity business area. The role offers extensive collaboration with engineering leaders, project execution teams, technology units, business units, and external engineering partners around the world. You will have the opportunity to influence both strategic development and operational excellence while leading a highly capable engineering team. 
We offer an inspiring and challenging position with international exposure and significant opportunities for personal and professional growth. You'll work in a collaborative, global environment where innovation, sustainability, and continuous learning are valued. In addition, we provide local benefits, modern tools, and flexible ways of working that support a healthy work-life balance.
Want to know more? 
For further information about the position please contact Tuomas Etula, Senior Manager, Mechanical Engineering, tuomas.etula@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via e-mail.  We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, please submit your application before November 27th. 
For positions with people leadership responsibilities in Sweden, delegated Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) responsibilities form an integral part of the role. Relevant information will be shared and discussed during the recruitment process.
We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.  
When everything works together  
Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Imagine joining our Mechanical Engineering team for Medium Gas Turbines, where your expertise will be vital in ensuring business continuity and supporting customer order engineering projects. In this role as a System Engineer, you will engage in advanced Mechanical System Design & Development, focusing on design of steel structures and installation solutions. You will tackle rigorous Technical Design creations in NX, Analysis & Problem Solving to optimize performance and efficiency, while also taking on Project Management & Other engineering disciplines. Mentorship responsibilities to guide processes and support junior team members. Your contribution will be essential in delivering comprehensive engineering solutions in customer order engineering projects. support from concept to execution.

How You’ll Make an Impact

●       Act as the responsible engineer within customer order projects.
●       Apply the full engineering design process to adapt designs to satisfy the customer needs 
●       Design innovative steel structures and installation solutions while producing manufacturing data in NX and associated technical documentation.
●       Engage with other package systems and contribute to the overall design philosophy of our gas turbine packages.
●       Collaborate with procurement and sub-suppliers to develop robust technical solutions, addressing generic issues and conducting root cause analyses.
●       Work closely with the project team to ensure design work aligns with the current schedule, creating, reviewing, and updating documentation within your technical area.

What You Bring  
●       A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent knowledge/ experience.
●       Professional experience in a mechanical engineering role, working with complex machinery or energy systems.
●       Strong understanding of applicable norms and standards in process and mechanical engineering, both EN and ASME. 
●       Proven experience managing engineering projects, preferably from a multicultural environment.
●       Experience with 3D CAD, preferably Siemens NX and Teamcenter.
●       Background within large industrial gas turbine engineering is a merit
●       Excellent teamwork skills, with a structured, driven approach to prioritizing and organizing your work effectively.
●       Good communication in both Swedish and English is preferred.

About the Team 
You will be part of a dedicated Mechanical Engineering team focused on the design and development of medium gas turbines. Our team is committed to innovation and excellence, working collaboratively to ensure the stability and performance of mechanical systems. Our responsibilities are design of steel structures and installation solutions both in workshop assembly stage and site installation stage. Our main responsibilities areas are gas turbine/generator base plate, gas turbine unit lifting tool, gas turbine core engine service roll-out tool, service platforms etc, and to adapt this to our customers specific requirements.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

We can offer you employment benefits such as reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

 
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo 

Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Join the world class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Health and Safety Manager. As the Health and Safety Manager you will own the Health and Safety function of your respective area. 
You will be responsible for improving the health and safety of our data centers, advancing safety culture, and protecting our employees. Each day you will work with our data center engineers, the people who make the cloud go. They are working with electrical switching equipment, large scale air handling mechanical systems, and critical IT gear. You will work closely with experts in security, construction, operations, logistics, compliance, corporate counsel, and human resources to further the global health safety program. You will partner with employees as well as contractors to achieve health and safety goals and improve our already strong safety culture. As AWS increases data capacity you will partner with construction managers to ensure risks are identified and mitigated prior to live operations. You will work in a fast-paced environment where our operations are rapidly changing, advocating safe changes in the face of new infrastructure, new tools, and new products/processes.
This role is for an experienced Safety Specialist or Safety Engineer. The role's prime responsibility will be to support the safety operations for Data Centers. You will be part of a regional and global team that works with internal and external partners to maintain and enhance the safety of operations. Close collaboration with onsite physical security, vendors, compliance officers, risk management, and fire/life safety systems is required. Additionally, you will work with employees and contractors to achieve specific safety objectives. You must be an effective communicator, sending clear, concise and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and/or public speaking forums. You will advise, instruct and train company personnel on safety policies and procedures, as well as assist the teams in incorporating and improving our safety standards at their sites. You will report to the Regional Safety Manager – EMEA and be responsible for continuing to enhance the safety of operations and construction. Some domestic and international travel is required. 
Key job responsibilities
Implement safety standards, policies and best practices.
Provision and Management of Training: Induction, Refresher Training as required, develop and deliver training/presentations to support achievement of H&S objectives. Ensure all H&S training requirements are fulfilled.
Collaborate with vendors (General Contractors, sub-contractors, Emergency Services) as they relate to operations and construction.
Ensure compliance and implementation of global safety programs and local regulatory legislation. 
Develop and review safety plans for on-site emergencies, special events and other unique safety situations.
Perform safety data analysis and create bench marking.
Ensure safety record keeping and provide accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
Consult and work with compliance teams on safety regulations interpretations and investigations. 
Develop and implement solutions to eliminate exposure to risks and prevent injury.
Adapt to fast-paced environments with changing circumstances, direction, strategy and deadlines. 
Able to work as part of a team and provide safety support to regions outside of local cluster when required.
Other duties as assigned.

About the team
We’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. 
Basic qualifications
Minimum 5+ years of field experience in in a Health & Safety role within operational environments. 
Fluent English language skill required (written and verbal communication). 
Valid driver's license.
Ability to work on-site at office and Data Center locations.

Preferred qualifications
Considerable knowledge of local safety and health regulatory laws and practices and workplace safety. 
Experience / knowledge of implementing safety programs, processes, and procedural documentation. 
Data center, manufacturing, construction, or similar industry safety experience with mix of full-time employees and third-party contractors.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon.

jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
We are currently recruiting two radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in coastal central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance, with daytime working hours and no evenings, nights, weekends or public holidays.
The department
The department is a smaller radiology unit with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with new technology, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, providing the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in a setting with a higher acute patient flow.
The role
The position includes standard duties as a radiographer, primarily within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00. There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous experience as a radiographer is an advantage but not a requirement. Experience with CT and conventional radiography is considered particularly valuable.
 
 
The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area combines small-town living with close access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to those looking for a quieter lifestyle with good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
The area offers access to schools and childcare, as well as good transport connections to larger cities.
Requirements
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised qualification as a Radiographer
The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
Is interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Enjoys working as part of a team and has as a professional and patient-centred approach
Has good communication skills in English
Is motivated to learn Swedish and adapt to the Swedish healthcare system
Is interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

 
Language and relocation
Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a Radiography Assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1.
Work and language training are combined during this period, with work in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
The language education is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin working fully as a radiographer once the required Swedish language level has been reached and Swedish professional authorization has been obtained.
Salary
During the language completion phase while employed as a Radiography Assistant, the salary is:
30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and beginning work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is:
31,100 SEK/month gross
The salary as an authorised radiographer may be individually determined depending on previous professional experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Application
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
Please submit:
CV / résumé
Diploma and educational certificates
Proof of professional license/registration
Motivation letter
References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

Interested?
If you are a qualified radiographer interested in building a long-term career and life in Sweden, we would be happy to hear from you.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:This is a senior and independent leadership position with responsibility for establishing global verification and validation practices across Surface Mining Automation. You will have a unique opportunity to influence technology decisions, quality standards, and release readiness across a portfolio of strategic automation programs.
 At Epiroc, we're accelerating the transformation of mining through automation and digitalization. As our Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will play a key role in ensuring that our solutions are safe, predictable, compliant, and ready to deliver value for our customers around the world.
 Join our team
 You will be part of Surface Mining R&D Automation, a globally connected organization developing autonomous and software-defined mining solutions. Together with colleagues across R&D, Systems Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, and Release Management, we create innovative technologies that improve safety, productivity, and sustainability in mining operations.
 Your mission
 As Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will establish and lead a global approach to verification and validation, helping ensure the successful delivery of automation solutions across regions and programs.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Defining and continuously improving a global verification and validation strategy aligned with the V-model.
  Leading system- and machine-level verification activities across integrated automation solutions.
 Establishing clear release-readiness criteria, quality gates, and data-driven decision frameworks.
 Ensuring traceability from requirements to verification results, supported by robust documentation and compliance processes.
 Collaborating with engineering teams to identify risks early and improve solution quality from the start.
 Enabling scalable verification through reusable test methods, assets, and environments including HiL, SIL, and virtual testing.
 Supporting FAT/SAT activities and customer acceptance processes.
 Developing global V&V capabilities, common ways of working, knowledge sharing, and a culture of continuous improvement.

The opportunity
This is a broad digital leadership role with responsibility for the systems and capabilities that support Lindex entire retail network. You have the opportunity to influence both operational reliability and the future development of the retail area.
The role combines a focused application portfolio with complex operational dependencies. A new point-of-sale system has recently been introduced and offers further development potential, while the continued establishment of new stores places clear demands on scalable processes and dependable infrastructure. You work closely with colleagues across Digital, Technology, Facilities, Properties and the wider business to turn retail priorities into sustainable digital solutions. You lead a multidisciplinary organisation that includes digital leads, developers and managers.
About the role
As Head of Digital – Retail, you hold strategic responsibility for the digital direction, capabilities and contribution to business performance across the company’s retail network. You translate Lindex’s overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital solutions, data, AI and technology to support sustainable growth, profitability and long-term business success.
Working in close partnership with business and functional leaders, you ensure that digital priorities are aligned with business objectives and translated into tangible results. You lead digital development across the retail network, balancing reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement and future-focused innovation. By strengthening digital capabilities and embedding new technologies into retail operations, you enhance the employee and customer experience while driving efficiency and operational performance.
You also lead competence development in new digital capabilities and ways of working, strengthening Lindex digital maturity and ability to embrace future opportunities. Through collaboration across the organisation, you ensure that digital development supports both current business needs and long-term strategic ambitions.
The Head of Digital – Retail holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).
Key responsibilities
Define the digital direction, priorities and roadmap for the retail area.
Ensure stable operations and continuous improvement of point-of-sale systems, RFID solutions, the employee retail app and security gate systems.
Identify opportunities to improve retail processes, including pricing, product handling and the establishment of new retails.
Monitor system performance and lead effective incident management for business-critical retail solutions.
Coordinate digital requirements with Facilities and Properties to secure connectivity, fibre infrastructure and appropriate technical retail formats.
Balance operational stability, incremental improvements and the development of new digital capabilities.
Lead a team of developers, digital leads and managers.
Contribute to the overall digital transformation as part of the Digital & Tech Manegement Team, driving digital competence development, AI adoption and new ways of working across the organisation.
Collaborate across the organization to align retail priorities with Lindex overall business, digital and technology direction.
Establish strategic leadership and clear ownership of digital partners and suppliers, ensuring strong performance and alignment with business objectives.

About you
You understand the complexity of retail operations and recognise how even small changes in technology can have a significant operational impact. You combine curiosity about retail with sound judgement, structured prioritisation and the ability to turn business needs into workable digital solutions. You provide clarity across organisational boundaries and maintain a strong focus on stability, performance and continuous improvement.
To succeed in the role, you need:
A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
Extensive experience in digital development and technology within a business context.
Extensive leadership experience, including leading managers, employees or cross-functional teams.
Experience translating business strategy and operational needs into digital priorities, capabilities and execution.
Experience leading digital products, platforms, data, automation, agile delivery, objectives and key results, and backlog prioritisation.
Experience driving organisational change, transformation and continuous improvement.
Strong communication skills and fluency in English.

It is an advantage if you have:
Experience from retail and a strong understanding of day-to-day retail operations.
Experience with point-of-sale systems, RFID technology, retail applications or other retail-related platforms.
Experience with monitoring, incident management and business-critical technical infrastructure.
Experience leading across reporting lines and building trust with business and digital stakeholders.
Experience from fashion, apparel, retail or another design-led product environment.

Location and Application
The position is based at the company’s head office in Gothenburg and requires regular on-site presence. International travel may be required.
We warmly welcome your application by 22 November via maquire.se (https://maquire.se/lediga-jobb/). If you have any questions, please contact Igor Glavan, 0701-765828, igor.glavan@jerrie.se or Jonna Berglöv, 0763-034100, jonna.berglov@jerrie.se

The opportunity
Hitachi Energy HVDC are doing something unique in the power industry – our technology enables greater amounts of power to reach customers with minimal environmental impact. As pioneers and market leaders in the field we deliver groundbreaking technology to customers all over the world!
We are looking to hire three Senior Tender Managers to our tender team within Hitachi Energy HVDC. We are looking for you who want to be part of the journey to enable grids for the future! We have a friendly, diverse, and multidisciplinary environment. This is a team that you can flourish in and where you are given responsibility as well as large degree of freedom to decide the path of the design and implementation.
As Senior Tender Manager, you are part of the product group HVDC within Hitachi Energy. This position is with placement either Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden, and require onsite attendance.
Are you curious about how you can contribute to Hitachi Energy, HVDC? Apply today!
How you’ll make an impact
As Senior Tender Manager your task will be to craft our bid strategy for a specific project, ensuring it is implemented and fulfilled, manage our client relations and ultimately that Hitachi Energy’s total offering is consolidated and conveyed.
You will be working closely with the business unit Grid Integration’s global sales team and be responsible for managing the entire bid process with the ultimate aim to present Hitachi Energy’s offer to the end client and securing the project, based on best competitiveness.
You will be leading a Bid & Proposal team of technical, legal, tax, insurance and commercial experts in digesting and translating client requirements and needs into a competitive overall solution based on the Hitachi Energy portfolio.
You should like to grow with the challenge that comes with the sales of large complex projects.
You should be enticed by working with complex tenders in a high performing international environment.
Our projects have extensive international coverage, which means that you will have frequent contacts with colleagues as well as clients in other countries, with focus on central and southern Europe in this role.

 
Your background
A minimum of 5 years experience of relevant work life experience: i.e from large complex tenders/projects, large scale system sales or large scale system tendering.
Experienced in leading cross-functional teams of 20+ individuals, with tight deadlines and fast international environment.
Enjoy working in teams in a high demand environment and are used to dealing with international business clients.
Technical and commercial experience of HVDC systems, or similar, is considered advantageous.
Used to handle many tasks simultaneously and to work structured and methodically.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Communicative and outgoing, especially since the position entails interaction with a wide variety of stakeholders, both internal and external across all organizational levels.

 
More about us
We are hiring three Senior Tender Managers. The location for this position is Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden.

Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. jobs.occupation: Software Product Developer to Mycronic Pattern Generator
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing.
In this role, you will be part of a larger team of 18 people responsible for the software and data processing that enable the machines to carry out their operations. The team works across a wide range of areas, from applications and data conversion to operating systems, computer hardware and internal networks. A key part of the work involves preparing and processing large volumes of data, with high demands on performance and reliability. This role will give you a broad understanding of how software and hardware interact within a complex system. You are not expected to know everything from day one. Curiosity, a willingness to learn and the ability to collaborate with colleagues with different areas of expertise are just as important.
Work tasks
In this role, you will have the opportunity to combine new product development with problem-solving and the continuous improvement of existing systems. Your primary focus will be software development in Java, where you will contribute to enhancing existing features, modernising systems, and addressing technical challenges within an advanced product environment. Your responsibilities will also include troubleshooting issues reported by customers, testing on physical test systems, and optimising code where performance is critical.
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
Developing and enhancing product software, primarily in Java.
Implementing new features and contributing to the modernisation of existing solutions while ensuring compatibility with previous product versions.
Writing tests and verifying functionality on physical test systems across various computer and system configurations.
Handling customer support cases through analysis and troubleshooting.
Developing software for user interaction and generating executable programs for the system.
Collaborating with colleagues across different technical disciplines to understand problems, identify solutions, and ensure that changes work seamlessly across the entire system.
Contributing ideas and suggestions for improvement as part of an ongoing product development process, driven by customer feedback and technological advancements.

We are looking for
To succeed in this role, you are curious and eager to understand how technology works as a whole. You take initiative, work independently and take ownership of your tasks, from initial analysis through to the delivery of a finished solution. At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and collaborating with others to achieve the best possible results. You are also adaptable, able to adjust when circumstances change, and thrive in a fast-paced development environment.
Furthermore, you have:
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.
At least a few years of experience in software development, working with products that combine both hardware and software.
Good knowledge of Java or experience with another object-oriented programming language, such as C++.
Experience in software development in a Linux environment.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience in user interface development, preferably using frameworks such as React or similar.
Knowledge of agile development methodologies.

Additional information
Start: By agreement 
Scope: Full-time 
Location: Täby

jobs.occupation: Licensed Veterinarian to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital
jobs.description:
We are looking for a licensed veterinarian with a few years of professional experience who wants to become part of our team and work broadly within small animal practice. With us, you will have the opportunity to use and further develop your expertise across several areas, from outpatient care and inpatient wards to emergency medicine, surgery, and on-call work.
About AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital
AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital provides highly qualified medical, emergency, and surgical veterinary care in a dynamic emergency setting and a welcoming environment.
AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital is part of Area North, which includes animal hospitals and clinics across fourteen locations. The hospital consists of the Emergency Department, Inpatient Care Ward, Surgery Department, Outpatient Clinic, Rehabilitation Department, as well as support functions including Telephone Services and Reception.
My name is Jens Berisson, and I work as the Hospital Director here at AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital. We are now looking to strengthen our fantastic team and are seeking a licensed veterinarian who is passionate about animal healthcare and wants to continue developing the hospital together with us.
About the Role
This role is ideal for someone who appreciates that no two days are the same. Your primary focus will be tailored to your experience and interests, but we would like you to be comfortable working across different areas of the hospital.
Examples of responsibilities include:

Outpatient consultations and medical workups.

Care of hospitalized patients in the inpatient ward.

Emergency patients and emergency medicine.

Surgery and perioperative care.

On-call and evening shifts.

More advanced cases based on your competence and experience.

Who Are You?
We believe you are a veterinarian who:

Is a licensed veterinarian with several years of clinical experience.

Is confident in your professional role and able to work independently.

Has experience from multiple areas of small animal practice, such as outpatient care, inpatient care, emergency medicine, and/or surgery.

Enjoys a varied caseload and is motivated to broaden your clinical expertise.

Is confident in making clinical decisions and prioritizing when required.

Has a genuine interest in high-quality patient care and professional communication with pet owners.

Is a team player who enjoys collaborating with skilled and dedicated colleagues.

Is curious and wants to continue developing professionally, whether by deepening expertise in a specific area or maintaining a broad clinical role.

Is fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Experience in emergency medicine, surgery, or a specialist qualification in canine and feline medicine is considered an advantage.
Why Choose AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital?
At AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital, you will become part of a dedicated and highly competent team where collaboration, job satisfaction, and patient focus are at the heart of everything we do.
We are a well-equipped animal hospital with extensive expertise in areas such as surgery, anaesthesia, emergency care, and advanced diagnostics. This provides excellent opportunities for both variety and continued professional development.
What many of our employees appreciate most is the strong sense of community. Here, we support one another, share knowledge, and work together to provide the best possible care for our patients.
About AniCura Sweden
Since 2018, AniCura Sweden has been part of Mars Veterinary Health, a global network that offers outstanding opportunities for knowledge sharing, innovation, and professional development.
With more than 450 clinics and animal hospitals across Europe, AniCura is one of the leading providers of advanced veterinary care. In Sweden, we are one of the largest veterinary care providers, with operations spanning the entire country and a strong local presence.
Our dedicated teams work together every day to provide the highest standard of care for every patient. Through a culture characterized by collaboration, continuous learning, and medical excellence, you will have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and truly make a difference.
We are covered by collective bargaining agreements and offer secure employment conditions, including occupational pension schemes, insurance coverage, and wellness benefits, as well as excellent opportunities for continued professional development throughout your career.
Would you like to bring your dog to work? No problem. We have spacious facilities specifically designated for employees' dogs.
Would You Like to Join Our Team?
If you are an experienced veterinarian who values variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to work across a broad range of disciplines, we would love to hear from you!
If you have questions about the position or your development opportunities with us, please contact:
Jens Berisson, Hospital Director jens.berisson@anicura.se
Emma Idman, Talent Acquisition Partner emma.idman@anicura.se
Welcome to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital – where you can make full use of your veterinary expertise.

Are you passionate about the intersection of Python programming, electronics, and radio frequency technology? On behalf of our client – an innovative and publicly listed telecom pioneer in Kista – Academic Work is looking for an RF Test Engineer. In this role, you will play a key part in the core R&D organization, developing automated test sequences for next-generation digital coverage solutions and 5G infrastructure. Apply today, as we apply ongoing selection!
About the role
Our client develops patented, digital coverage solutions (Distributed Antenna Systems) engineered for demanding environments such as rail and road tunnels, subways, arenas, and large commercial venues. Their systems support commercial cellular networks from 2G up to 5G, as well as mission-critical public safety networks. In this position, you will join a specialized hardware development team of around six engineers at the global headquarters in Kista. The role is focused on the intersection of software and electronics: your primary mission is to build, maintain, and optimize automated RF test sequences and scripts in Python to verify products at both module and system level before they transition into series production. Because the position requires hands-on verification with instruments and test rigs in the laboratory, work is primarily conducted on-site in Kista, with the possibility of working remotely one day per week.
You will act as an essential link between internal R&D and manufacturing. Internally, you will collaborate daily with hardware, mechanics, and radio engineers, as well as a larger software development team. You will have no direct customer-facing duties; instead, your primary external stakeholders are production partners and manufacturing facilities in Sweden and Estonia. The role includes occasional travel—approximately 3 to 4 weeks per year—to install, configure, and troubleshoot test setups on-site at the manufacturing plants. You will become part of an open, supportive engineering culture characterized by flat hierarchies, shared daily fika breaks, and a transparent mindset where catching mistakes early and solving complex challenges together is valued above all else.
You are offered:
A technically versatile role working with cutting-edge 5G and cellular hardware solutions.
A tight-knit, collaborative team culture with short decision paths and high engineering expertise.
Occupational pension aligned with ITP1, wellness allowance, and free access to the building’s gym facilities.

Work tasks
Develop automated RF test sequences using Python, perform hardware lab verifications, and coordinate with production sites to ensure product quality.
Develop, maintain, and execute automated RF test sequences and scripts using Python.  
Perform test and verification at module and system levels on proprietary hardware and electronics.  
Set up and operate automated test equipment (ATE) and RF lab instruments, including spectrum analyzers and signal generators.  
Build, commission, and optimize automated test rigs for both laboratory development and factory production.  
Conduct lab-based hardware troubleshooting and analysis down to board and component levels.  
Collaborate closely with software and radio engineers to expand test coverage and streamline test cycles.  
Support external manufacturing partners and travel to production sites (approx. 3–4 weeks/year) to deploy and verify test setups.  
Document test methods, procedures, and test results within Jira and Confluence.

We are looking for
An academic degree in Electrical Engineering, Wireless Communication, Applied Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.
At least 1 year of documented professional experience in Python programming for automation, scripting, or hardware test control - either from your education or previous work experience.
Practical hands-on experience working with RF test instrumentation (e.g., spectrum analyzers, signal generators) or Automated Test Equipment (ATE).
Good technical understanding of cellular standards such as LTE (4G) and 5G NR.
Comfort working in Linux environments and performing hands-on lab work.
Strong proficiency in English, both written and spoken, as it is used in technical documentation and manufacturing communication.
This position requires that you hold a valid work permit or have the legal right to work in Sweden.

It is meritorious if you have
Experience reading electronic schematics and circuit diagrams.
Knowledge of database management and SQL.
Familiarity with version control (Git) and project tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Practical experience with hardware prototyping platforms (e.g., Raspberry Pi).

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Intellectually curious
Respectful

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.
